From the bookshelf

The debut novel

The Eightfold Covenant · Book One

The Mercy of Ruin

When raiders burn Zion’s Vale, former Sentinel Jovan Ga’al emerges from the flames with a mysterious medallion—and a forbidden power he once spent years policing. Far away, sheltered Dreamer Eazra Horama witnesses an impossible darkness spreading through visions of a forgotten age.

As their paths converge, ancient relics resurface, old enemies begin to move, and the magic civilization depends upon reveals a darker cost.

About the author

Stories of courage, mystery, and the price of power.

Michael Eidson is the author of The Mercy of Ruin, the first installment of The Eightfold Covenant. His debut blends frontier adventure, political intrigue, ancient mysteries, dangerous magic, and hard-won fellowship.
